description: Use when you have an arXiv id (new-style like 1706.03762 or with version 1706.03762v7, or old-style like hep-ex/0307015) and need its public metadata card: title, abstract/summary, authors with affiliations (emails removed), primary category, all categories, published and updated timestamps, author comment, journal reference, DOI, and abs/PDF URLs. Without a version suffix, arXiv returns the latest version. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

id.description: arXiv id, optionally with version (e.g. 1706.03762 or 1706.03762v7).
